title: Creating a Receipt and Receipt Line
titles: Creating a Receipt and Receipt Line

children: Creating a Receipt and Receipt Line

Receipts can either be interfaced from the ERP or created in the system. 
 All product introduced to the warehouse must be associated with a receipt 
 record. The receipt record includes such values as address information, 
 status, and other miscellaneous values. The receipt line record represents 
 the actual item and quantity that you want to receive into your warehouse. 
 All receipt lines are associated with a receipt record. You can 
 also create receipts from shipments, using the Receipt From Shipment 
 Screen (accessed via the Shipment Insight Screen).
Checking In and Locating a Receipt Line (RF)
The following is discussed in this topic:

The following information is a general description 
 of each field section used in creating a receipt in SCALE. For specific definitions 
 of a certain field, see the "Field Links" section of this topic, 
 or type the field name into the help index.
- Access the Receipt Insight screen, and select the New action. The system will display the Receipt Screen in new mode.

- You can use these fields to indicate the values of various fields associated 
 with this receipt, including Receipt ID and Receipt ID Type.
- When finished, press the Save button, and the system will save the receipt.

- You can use these fields to provide the address information for the source entity of this 
 receipt.

- You can use these fields to provide the address information 
 for the ship from entity of this receipt.
- You can use these fields to view the statuses associated with this receipt.
- You can use these fields to indicate the carrier information for this receipt.

- You can use these fields to assign various dates associated with this 
 receipt.
- You can use these fields to view the items associated with this receipt.

- Clicking on the New Line action will open the Receipt Line Screen in a new mode. Clicking on Save on that screen shows a success message and the screen gets refreshed so that you can enter another detail and so on.
- If you click on Cancel, the screen goes back to the Receipt Screen and then system will display all the new receipt lines that got added under the Lines section of the screen.
- You can use these fields to view summary information associated with this receipt.
- You can use these fields to view the customized data.

The following information is a general 
 description of each section used in creating a receipt line. For specific 
 definitions of a certain field, see the "Field Links" section 
 of this topic, or type the field name into the help index.
- Access the Receipt Line Insight Screen, and select the New action. The system will display the Receipt Line Screen in new mode.

- You can use these fields to indicate the item and lot that you 
 want on this receipt line.

- You can use these fields to indicate the amount of the item that you 
 want on this receipt line.

- You can use these fields to define the physical attributes of the 
 item included on this receipt line.

- You can use these fields to define miscellaneous properties of the 
 item included on this receipt line.

- You can use these fields to indicate certain values that affect how 
 the system will putaway this item quantity.
- You can use these fields to view/indicate various receipt-related values.

- You can use these fields to associate user-defined item categories 
 to this receipt line.
- When finished, press the Save button, and the system will save the receipt line.
- You can use these fields to view the customized data.
